toast.dryRunCancelled: ⏱ Check cancelled; remaining items not validated.
toast.deletedTitle: ✓ Moved {{count}} items to trash — recoverable anytime
toast.deleteCancelled: ⏱ Deletion cancelled: remaining items kept in the list and selection.

confirm.subtitle: Recoverable from the trash; regenerate as hinted when needed.

deps.emptyTitle: Pick a project folder with package.json, then “Analyze deps”
deps.emptySub: Find declared-but-never-imported deps and slim precisely instead of nuking the whole install
deps.migrateHint: Migrating to pnpm dedupes packages across projects via a content-addressed store — a major disk saver when dev-sweeper scans many projects.
deps.alreadyPnpmSuffix: — enjoying cross-project dedupe from content-addressed storage.
deps.extraneousTitle: node_modules dirs missing from package.json ({{count}} — may include transitive deps):
deps.pruneToastDry: Dry-run: would remove {{count}} deps — nothing changed
deps.migrateToastDry: Dry-run: would migrate this {{pm}} project to pnpm (old node_modules trashed, then rebuilt) — nothing changed
deps.migrateToastDone: Migrated to pnpm, freed {{size}}; old node_modules is in the trash
deps.migrateRecover: Old node_modules is in the trash — restore it and run `pnpm install` manually
deps.migrateDescPrefix: The old node_modules and lockfile are moved to the trash (recoverable) first, freeing disk instantly; then
deps.migrateDescSuffix: rebuilds the dependencies. pnpm’s content-addressed store dedupes across projects and saves a lot of space.
deps.cancelMigrateTitle: Kill the pnpm child process; finished steps are not rolled back (old node_modules is recoverable in the trash)
deps.pruneDescPrefix: package.json is backed up to package.json.sweep.bak first; matching node_modules dirs go to the trash (recoverable). Runtime deps (high confidence) are safe to remove; dev deps (needs review) — confirm they aren’t used by CLIs/configs first.
deps.logPrune: Log prune decisions (~/.dev-sweeper/decisions.jsonl, off by default)
deps.logPruneTitle: When on, every real prune records time and dependency names into ~/.dev-sweeper/decisions.jsonl. Shares the same switch with the clean panel. Off by default.

caches.title: Global dependency caches
caches.introSuffix: (outside any project, so normal cleanup never touches them): clearing only means re-downloading — no source code is lost; everything goes to the trash and is recoverable.
caches.emptyTitle: No global dependency caches found (or toolchains aren’t installed)
caches.emptySub: Manage npm / pip / cargo / maven / gradle / go / uv / pnpm global caches here
caches.riskNoticeTitle: Clearing loses cross-project dedupe / needs re-download
caches.toastDry: Dry-run: would clean {{count}} global caches, freeing {{size}} — nothing deleted
caches.toastDone: ✓ Cleaned global caches, freed {{size}} — recoverable in the trash
caches.confirmDesc: These caches are shared by package managers and live outside projects. They go to the trash and can be restored anytime, or regenerated as hinted.

archive.introSuffix: into .tar.gz archives; the originals go to the trash — no source is lost, and “Restore” brings them back. This is the core of “slim down without deleting”: live code stays, it just stops hogging workspace space.
archive.title: Dormant projects
archive.empty: Projects idle for over {{days}} days appear here; none found, or they’re all fresh
archive.libEmpty: Archive library is empty — archived projects will appear here, restorable in one click
archive.restorePickFirst: Pick a root folder first as the restore target
archive.restoreNoRoot: Pick a project root folder in the top bar first (as the restore target)
archive.toastDry: Dry-run: would archive {{count}} projects, freeing {{size}} — nothing done
archive.toastDone: ✓ Archived {{count}} projects, {{size}} compressed; originals moved to trash
archive.confirmDesc: Each project is packed into .tar.gz (default ~/dev-archives); the original goes to the trash. No source is lost and everything is restorable. Emptying the trash frees the space for real.

excludes.title: Excluded paths
excludes.descSuffix: during scanning and cleaning — never identified as artifacts, never deleted. Use it to protect important projects, system folders, or anywhere you never want touched.
excludes.addPlaceholder: Or paste a path and press Enter to add
excludes.dup: This path is already in the exclusion list
excludes.empty: No exclusions yet. Added folders will be skipped while scanning.
excludes.hintPrefix: Tip: exclusions match by path prefix. Excluding
